tasks.title: One-shot sparse issue create
tasks.goal: The release renderer opens exactly one issue: title plus the operator's project-document intent prose rendered verbatim (render_project_task_body/project_tasks lineage, campaign.rs 2827/2899) -- no manifest section, no worklist section, no markers in the human surface. Falsifiable test: the issue could exist unchanged in a repository that never heard of tally (Decision D4, D46). Idempotent: re-running creates nothing.
deliveredBehaviors: One sparse issue per campaign, created once
No fenced machine sections in issue bodies

acceptanceCriteria.description: Renderer unit tests pass including the idempotency case.

tasks.title: Stack-as-projection renderer
tasks.goal: Render the release as a stack of per-layer PRs over stable_publish_branch names and dependency levels (the frontier loop is already a level-by-level cut), pushed fast-forward from the local integration branch under the merge-control ruling. The stack is a review projection; merged-bottom-up is presentation. Squash-merge is refused on projection repos (it destroys the trailer block, Decision D23, D28-D29). Commit messages render from the ledger: type from task kind, scope from conflict domain, subject from brief, body from receipts, trailer block per Decision D19.
deliveredBehaviors: The public stack is a projection of the local integration
Every layer commit carries the validated trailer block

acceptanceCriteria.description: Driver suite passes with the stack renderer.

tasks.title: Commit grammar validator and tally lint-history
tasks.goal: Implement the ~150-line Rust validator holding authority at the render: type-enum (feat fix refactor docs build chore), scope-enum (closed per-repo subsystem list), subject-case, subject-full-stop, header-max-length 72, body-leading-blank, footer-leading-blank, trailer-block-wellformed (one contiguous block, BREAKING-CHANGE hyphenated). Expose tally lint-history <range> for on-demand audit. git-cliff may be run externally as a conformance oracle; it is not a dependency (Decision D25-D26).
deliveredBehaviors: No commit reaches the projection without passing the validator
tally lint-history audits any range on demand

acceptanceCriteria.description: Validator unit tests pass, including a trailer-block-poisoning negative case.

tasks.title: Receipts summary and close, idempotent terminal pass
tasks.goal: Render the closing receipts summary from campaign_digest (3715) / render_campaign_summary (3805) into the single closing comment (60,000-char bound survives as a renderer constraint), close the issue, and prove the terminal pass idempotent: re-running creates nothing (markers/closing_summary_marker discipline).
deliveredBehaviors: One closing summary rendered from the ledger

acceptanceCriteria.description: Driver suite passes including terminal idempotency.

tasks.title: tally-probe scratch repo lifecycle
tasks.goal: Implement the probe lifecycle per Decision D9: tally-probe-<date>-<short> creation and deletion by one verb; the renderer mechanically refuses any repository that is not the armed code repository unless a probe flag is set, and the probe flag refuses any repo not matching tally-probe-*; a TTL sweep deletes probes older than 7 days; probes are private, never forks; no probe state is read back except a pass/fail witness line. Run one end-to-end probe campaign (sparse issue, stack, merges, summary, close, re-run-creates-nothing) and one stack-renderer probe against a resettable scratch repo.
deliveredBehaviors: The release act is exercised off the production repo
Teardown is a glob plus a TTL, not a list

acceptanceCriteria.description: The probe harness reports a green end-to-end release act.
